label: Mosquito in a flight simulator
notes: Tethered mosquito, closed-loop visual flight simulator, 12.5 min at ~165 Hz resampled to 40 Hz (σ 8 ms). hover_vision.h5's /df store is byte-identical to this one, so only one fly is frozen. A driver: never drawn as a shape.

channels.steer: left−right wingbeat amplitude (wbad): the fly's steering command, signed
channels.effort: left+right wingbeat amplitude (wbas): flight effort; < 0.3 = wings stopped
channels.heading: the fly's heading in the simulator, degrees, continuous (trial resets removed); some trials spin at hundreds of degrees per second
